relation_statement: The truncated-normal init distribution's cutoff must equal the user-supplied init_cutoff_factor under guard: Mitchell init path.
observable_signal: Truncation width (max|w|/std) of the sampled init weights vs configured cutoff_factor.
validity_precondition: init_fn=mitchell for OLMoBlock/OLMoSequentialBlock/OLMoLlamaBlock and wte init
evidence_from_issue: Mitchell init hardcodes cutoff_factor=3.0, ignoring user-supplied init_cutoff_factor
evidence_from_fix: every code path literally assigned cutoff_factor = 3.0, ignoring config.init_cutoff_factor, producing narrower truncated-normal weights

relation_statement: Leftover indices must partition disjointly and completely across DataLoader workers under guard: drop_last=False and num_workers>1.
observable_signal: Union and pairwise overlap of per-worker leftover index sets vs full leftover set.
validity_precondition: IterableDataset with drop_last=False, device_batch_size set, num_workers>1, indices not divisible by batch size
evidence_from_issue: IterableDataset leftover indices distributed wrongly across workers
evidence_from_fix: contiguous slice made workers overlap and miss leftovers; fix uses strided slicing so each worker picks its share

relation_statement: Each epoch must yield the full reshuffled index set exactly once (start offset reset to 0) under guard: epoch boundary crossing.
observable_signal: Count of examples yielded in an epoch vs dataset length; dataset.start_index at epoch start.
validity_precondition: max_epochs>1, crossing an epoch boundary mid-training
evidence_from_issue: Dataset start_index not reset when starting a new epoch
evidence_from_fix: forgot to reset self.dataset.start_index=0, so new epoch dropped a prefix and was shortened

relation_statement: The readout (MuReadout) weights must retain the muP prescribed zero/special init and not be overwritten by generic truncated-normal init under guard: use_mup enabled.
observable_signal: ff_proj weight values/std after reset_parameters vs muP prescribed zero init.
validity_precondition: OLMoSequentialBlock with use_mup=True (or full_megatron init) where ff_proj is a MuReadout
evidence_from_issue: Block readout init unconditionally re-initializes ff_proj, overwriting muP zero-init
evidence_from_fix: unconditional init_normal overwrote MuReadout zero init, breaking muP coordinate-check guarantee

relation_statement: q_norm and k_norm must be constructed with the same elementwise_affine flag equal to the configured value under guard: QK norm enabled.
observable_signal: Presence/absence of learnable scale/bias parameters in q_norm vs k_norm vs config.attention_layer_norm_with_affine.
validity_precondition: attention_layer_norm=True and attention_layer_norm_with_affine=False
evidence_from_issue: q_norm forced to elementwise_affine=True regardless of attention_layer_norm_with_affine
evidence_from_fix: k_norm used config flag but q_norm hard-coded True, breaking q/k symmetry and adding unrequested params

relation_statement: The token embedding table row count must equal the output projection's class count under guard: weight_tying=False.
observable_signal: Shape mismatch between wte.num_embeddings and ff_out.out_features; logits for ids in [vocab_size, embedding_size).
validity_precondition: embedding_size set distinct from vocab_size, weight_tying=False
evidence_from_issue: Token embedding sized by vocab_size instead of embedding_size, mismatching ff_out width
evidence_from_fix: wte used vocab_size but ff_out sized for embedding_size, so extra logits bias the softmax denominator with no learnable embedding

relation_statement: All parameters must carry the designed init (reset_parameters applied) rather than FSDP default/zero fill under guard: meta-device init with FSDP.
observable_signal: Per-parameter statistics (std, all-zero/uninitialized check) after FSDP materialization.
validity_precondition: torch>=2.1, FSDP wrapping with init_device='meta'
evidence_from_issue: Missing reset_parameters() after FSDP wrap on torch>=2.1 leaves model with default-initialized weights
evidence_from_fix: FSDP no longer auto-calls reset_parameters; params left uninitialized/zero-filled, destroying init scheme

relation_statement: The readout ff_out must be created on the configured init_device and receive the designed init scale, not default kaiming init, under guard: meta-init with FSDP.
observable_signal: ff_out weight std and device vs the model's init pipeline output.
validity_precondition: init_device='meta', FSDP enabled (lazy materialization expected)
evidence_from_issue: ff_out nn.Linear constructed without device=init_device, breaking meta-init flow
evidence_from_fix: omitted device kwarg for ff_out so it got default kaiming init on default device, escaping init pipeline

relation_statement: reset_parameters must run for the standard-parametrization baseline (infshapes=None) so params are not left FSDP-default under guard: SP coord-check load path.
observable_signal: Parameter std / near-zero check for the SP baseline after load_model.
validity_precondition: mup_olmo coord-check SP baseline path with infshapes=None
evidence_from_issue: load_model in mup coord-check skips reset_parameters when infshapes is None
evidence_from_fix: reset_parameters nested inside if infshapes is not None, so SP baseline skipped it, leaving default near-zero params

relation_statement: The learning rate must decay (non-increase) after the warmup peak rather than hold constant under guard: DeepSpeedTrainer post-warmup.
observable_signal: Learning-rate trajectory over steps after warmup completes.
validity_precondition: DeepSpeedTrainer in use, training long enough that decay matters
evidence_from_issue: DeepSpeed scheduler set to WarmupLR instead of WarmupDecayLR (no decay phase)
evidence_from_fix: WarmupLR only ramps then holds LR constant; intended WarmupDecayLR ramps then linearly decays

relation_statement: Checkpoint retention must evict oldest first and never delete the just-saved newest checkpoint under guard: keep-count reached.
observable_signal: Whether the most recently saved checkpoint directory still exists after the retention/deletion loop.
validity_precondition: save_num_checkpoints_to_keep>0 and list already at capacity when a new save fires
evidence_from_issue: Newest checkpoint deleted by retention policy because it is appended after pruning
evidence_from_fix: new entry appended after the deletion loop; fix appends before dist.barrier so retention sees the new entry

relation_statement: The dataset example budget must equal max_steps times device_train_batch_size under guard: batch_size>1.
observable_signal: Number of examples the loader yields before exhaustion vs max_duration*batch_size.
validity_precondition: IterableDataset with max_steps param, device_train_batch_size>1
evidence_from_issue: Train DataLoader max_steps not multiplied by device_train_batch_size
evidence_from_fix: max_steps passed in optimizer steps not examples, so loader exhausts after ~1/batch_size of planned training; start_step also unscaled

relation_statement: The fused cross-entropy path's effective z-loss multiplier must equal the configured value (nonzero when enabled) under guard: fused_loss and z-loss enabled.
observable_signal: Whether the z-loss term actually affects gradients/lse magnitude vs the logged nonzero z_loss value.
validity_precondition: softmax_auxiliary_loss=True and fused_loss=True (FlashAttention CrossEntropyLoss path)
evidence_from_issue: Fused cross_entropy path passes lse_square_scale=0 so z-loss term is silently dropped
evidence_from_fix: lse_square_scale hard-coded 0.0 disables the fused z-loss even though surrounding code adds a logged z_loss

relation_statement: The model's eos_token_id must equal the tokenizer's actual EOS id under guard: dolma/GPT-NeoX tokenizer.
observable_signal: Document-boundary/loss-mask token id used vs tokenizer eos_token_id (50279).
validity_precondition: scripts/ladder.py builds 150M config with dolma/GPT-NeoX tokenizer
evidence_from_issue: Ladder script uses eos_token_id=0 instead of dolma tokenizer's 50279
evidence_from_fix: hard-coded eos_token_id=0 treats an ordinary BPE token as boundary and never recognizes real EOS

relation_statement: The effective load-balancing aux loss per global batch must be invariant to the number of micro-batches (divided by num_micro_batches) under guard: gradient accumulation with MoE.
observable_signal: Accumulated aux-loss contribution / router-pressure gradient magnitude vs num_micro_batches.
validity_precondition: block_type=moe, moe_expert_choice=False, num_micro_batches>1
evidence_from_issue: MoE load-balancing loss not divided by num_micro_batches in gradient accumulation loop
evidence_from_fix: full aux loss added per micro-batch without dividing, scaling LB regularizer by N micro-batches

relation_statement: The block output must preserve the residual/identity path (output = sublayer(x) + x) and not overwrite the residual input under guard: attention norm applied.
observable_signal: Presence of the additive residual connection in block output vs input activation.
validity_precondition: transformer block with attention normalization
evidence_from_issue: Attention norm overwrites residual input — destroys identity path
evidence_from_fix: no root_cause provided; title indicates residual/identity path is destroyed

relation_statement: soft_target_probs must preserve floating-point dtype through as_tensor and not be truncated to int under guard: non-bool numpy float array.
observable_signal: Dtype of the resulting target tensor and whether probabilities were floored to integers.
validity_precondition: soft target probabilities passed through local as_tensor()
evidence_from_issue: soft_target_probs silently truncated from float to int by as_tensor()
evidence_from_fix: local as_tensor casts non-bool numpy arrays via astype(np.int_), destroying float probabilities

relation_statement: Each attention projection's init std must use its actual fan-in (in_features) rather than a single d_model**-0.5 under guard: GQA / w_out fan-in differs from d_model.
observable_signal: Per-projection init weight std vs the fan-in-derived expected std.
validity_precondition: InitMethod.claude selected, GQA (n_kv_heads!=n_heads) or w_out where in_features!=d_model
evidence_from_issue: Attention claude-init uses d_model**-0.5 instead of actual w.in_features**-0.5
evidence_from_fix: single std=d_model**-0.5 assumed identical fan-in across Q/K/V and w_out, scaling init wrong

relation_statement: A document's attention output must be invariant to packing, i.e. rotary positions restart at each document boundary, under guard: cu_doc_lens provided.
observable_signal: Rotary phase / attention output of a document when packed vs standalone.
validity_precondition: multiple documents packed with cu_doc_lens, non-fused RotaryEmbedding path
evidence_from_issue: Per-document RoPE positions not propagated when cu_doc_lens is provided in packed mode
evidence_from_fix: Attention.forward called self.rope without forwarding cu_doc_lens, so later docs got global positions

relation_statement: Rotary positions for each batch element must be computed against that element's own document boundaries under guard: B>1 with differing per-element doc layouts.
observable_signal: Positions/doc indices for batch element >0 vs its own cu_doc_lens boundaries.
validity_precondition: packed-document training with cu_doc_lens, batch_size>1, per-element differing boundaries
evidence_from_issue: RotaryEmbedding cu_doc_lens path miscomputes positions for B>1 — second batch element reuses batch-0 doc layout
evidence_from_fix: positions=arange(k_len) without per-batch offset; searchsorted against batch-0 boundaries

relation_statement: GatedDeltaNet A_log/dt_bias must receive the GDN-prescribed init rather than uninitialized empty memory or default linear init under guard: hybrid model with GatedDeltaNet mixer.
observable_signal: A_log/dt_bias values after init (finite, on-distribution) vs uninitialized/NaN memory.
validity_precondition: hybrid model includes GatedDeltaNet, block init used generic InitMethod path
evidence_from_issue: GatedDeltaNet A_log/dt_bias initialized as empty (uninit memory) and miss the GDN-prescribed init
evidence_from_fix: generic InitMethod did not delegate to the mixer, so params fell back to torch.empty or default inits

relation_statement: The logged aux-loss metric must be invariant to activation checkpointing (counted once per step) under guard: act-checkpoint wraps the MoE block.
observable_signal: Logged per-step aux-loss metric vs true value (2x when forward reruns).
validity_precondition: MoEFusedV2TransformerBlock with routed_experts_router, activation checkpointing enabled
evidence_from_issue: MoE load-balancing aux loss accumulated to metrics twice when activation checkpointing recomputes the block
evidence_from_fix: compute_aux_loss accumulated on every forward; act-ckpt reruns forward in backward, adding it twice

relation_statement: A named data-mix enum key must map to the corpus path it names under guard: user selects the 0625 mix.
observable_signal: Resolved corpus path/identity vs the requested mix name (0625 vs 0725).
validity_precondition: user selects DataMix.OLMo_midtraining_mix_0625_100B
evidence_from_issue: OLMo midtraining mix key references the wrong file — '0625' name maps to '0725' path
evidence_from_fix: enum value OLMo_midtraining_mix_0625_100B='...0725-100B' silently routed to the July mix

relation_statement: The RMSNorm weight multiply must be performed in the input dtype (bf16, cast back before multiply) to match trained Qwen3 semantics under guard: Qwen3 factory with bf16 inputs.
observable_signal: Numeric divergence of RMSNorm output from HF Qwen3RMSNorm reference on outlier channels.
validity_precondition: qwen3 model factory used with mixed-precision bf16 inputs
evidence_from_issue: RMSNorm casts back to og_dtype after weight multiply, diverging from HF Qwen3
evidence_from_fix: olmo-core did normalize->multiply->cast (multiply in fp32); HF casts before multiply so it is in bf16

relation_statement: Expert/router gradients must flow unmasked (not zeroed) unless the freeze mode is active under guard: plain TransformerTrainModule.
observable_signal: Gradient norm of the first-half expert/router parameters during a normal (non-freeze) training run.
validity_precondition: TransformerTrainModule used directly, params named 'experts'/'router', freeze off
evidence_from_issue: Expert/router gradients zeroed unconditionally in train_batch — first-half mask applied even when freeze_experts is off
evidence_from_fix: freeze masking moved to module-level train_batch so parent zeroed first half of experts on every run

relation_statement: Config encode/decode round-trip must reproduce an equivalent config, excluding init=False derived fields, under guard: dataclass with field(init=False).
observable_signal: Equality of decode(encode(config)) vs original; crash on unknown kwargs or stale derived value.
validity_precondition: Config dataclass has field(init=False) derived fields and is serialized via as_dict
evidence_from_issue: Config encoding ignores field.init=False — non-init dataclass fields silently round-trip with stale values
evidence_from_fix: as_dict dumped init=False fields, re-passed to constructor, overwriting post_init-derived values

relation_statement: The loader's token_dtype must match the on-disk token dtype (uint32 for vocab>65535) under guard: no explicit token_dtype given.
observable_signal: Token IDs in-range vs corrupted; loader dtype vs file dtype.
validity_precondition: tokenizer vocab_size>65535, PerFileChunkedInstanceSourceConfig without explicit token_dtype
evidence_from_issue: defaults token_dtype to uint16 — silent token-id corruption for vocab > 65535
evidence_from_fix: default uint16 reinterprets uint32 file bytes as separate tokens, producing wrong in-range IDs

relation_statement: The total gradient norm across the PP group must be the L2 reduction (sqrt of summed squares) not a sum-of-norms under guard: pipeline parallelism.
observable_signal: Computed total_grad_norm magnitude vs the true global L2 norm; resulting clip factor.
validity_precondition: pipeline parallelism (mesh dim 'pp'), MoEFusedV2Optimizer in use
evidence_from_issue: reduces PP grad norm with _combine_norm (sum-of-norms) instead of _reduce_norm — over-counts gradient magnitude
evidence_from_fix: _combine_norm added rank-local norms instead of squaring/all-reducing/sqrt, over-estimating global norm

relation_statement: The cached index file must be read as a complete, consistent artifact (atomic write, deterministic ordering) despite concurrent writers under guard: shared work_dir.
observable_signal: Index file completeness/consistency and ordering identity across concurrent runs.
validity_precondition: multiple jobs share work_dir, SamplingInstanceSource rank-0 builds indices
evidence_from_issue: SamplingInstanceSource cache write race — concurrent ladder runs overwrite each other's index files
evidence_from_fix: rank-0 always rewrote via tmp_path.replace, racing so training read partially-written/shuffled indices

relation_statement: Temp filenames must be unique across concurrent ranks/processes and not collide under identical RNG seeds under guard: parallel preprocessing of the same path.
observable_signal: Distinctness of per-rank tmp_path values; collision / FileNotFound on replace.
validity_precondition: multiple ranks preprocess same path with same global seed, memmap_to_write used
evidence_from_issue: memmap_to_write tmp filename uses seeded random — concurrent writers collide on identical path
evidence_from_fix: temp name via random.randint seeded by global RNG; identical seeds gave identical tmp_path across ranks

relation_statement: MoE-shaped gradients must be correctly all-reduced (per-bucket, with comm_dtype downcast) and consistent across DP ranks, never zeroed, under guard: EP+DP MoE with MultiGroup DDP.
observable_signal: Per-parameter gradient values after reduction (nonzero, equal across DP ranks) and NCCL volume.
validity_precondition: MoE training with MultiGroupDistributedDataParallel, MoE-shaped params needing bucketed reduction
evidence_from_issue: MultiGroupDistributedDataParallel ... never wires per-bucket grad reduce
evidence_from_fix: MoE params reduced one-by-one, missing view-based bucket batching; skipped comm_dtype downcast and occasionally zeroed partial buckets
